description: This file defines classes, functions, and utilities related to memory planning, buffer sorting, and scheduling for PyTorch's inductor JIT compiler, specifically focusing on estimating peak memory usage, validating dependency graphs, and reordering nodes for optimal memory utilization.

classes.name: PeakMemoryResult
classes.description: Holds the result of a memory estimation, including node order, peak memory, and method used.

classes.name: MemoryPlanningInfoForBuffer
classes.description: Contains memory planning info for buffers, including size and successor nodes.

classes.name: MemoryPlanningInfoForNode
classes.description: Holds memory planning info for a scheduler node, including index, size, predecessor buffers, and successor nodes.

classes.name: FreeableInputBuffer
classes.description: Represents an input buffer that can potentially be freed; stores its name and associated memory info.

classes.name: BufferInfo
classes.description: Stores info about a buffer's size and lifetime (start and end steps).

classes.name: SNodeMemory
classes.description: Tracks memory allocated and freed for a scheduler node during its phases.

methods.name: dict[str,FreeableInputBuffer] get_freeable_input_buf( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], graph_inputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Generates a mapping of input buffers that can be freed during execution, based on dependencies and input set.

methods.name: dict[str,tuple[int,int]] compute_size_for_scheduler_buffer( name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], )
methods.description: Calculates size allocations and deallocations for scheduler buffers, considering in-place mutations and multi-output layouts.

methods.name: None assign_memory_planning_info_for_scheduler_buffers( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], )
methods.description: Assigns memory size and successor nodes info to each scheduler buffer.

methods.name: None assign_memory_planning_info_for_scheduler_nodes( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_fused_node: dict[str, BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], )
methods.description: Links scheduler nodes with their predecessor buffers, successor nodes, and memory info.

methods.name: tuple[list[BufferInfo],dict[BaseSchedulerNode,int],dict[Union[FreeableInputBuffer,SchedulerBuffer],BaseSchedulerNode],] compute_memory_timeline( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Determines the lifetime (allocation to deallocation) of buffers throughout the schedule.

methods.name: tuple[int,list[int]] estimate_peak_memory( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Estimates the maximum memory usage during execution for a given node order.

methods.name: tuple[int,list[tuple[int,int]],dict[BaseSchedulerNode,SNodeMemory],dict[Union[FreeableInputBuffer,SchedulerBuffer],BaseSchedulerNode],] estimate_peak_memory_allocfree( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Alternative peak memory estimator considering different execution phases of nodes.

methods.name: list[BaseSchedulerNode] topological_sort_lpmf( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Heuristic topological sort aiming to minimize peak memory based on live memory during scheduling.

methods.name: list[BaseSchedulerNode] topological_sort_bfs(nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode])
methods.description: Breadth-first topological sort prioritizing nodes with earliest dependencies.

methods.name: list[BaseSchedulerNode] topological_sort_dfs(nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode])
methods.description: Depth-first topological sort based on buffer read/write sizes for node ordering.

methods.name: None validate_graph_acyclic(nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode])
methods.description: Checks if the dependency graph has cycles; raises error if cycle detected.

methods.name: None validate_unique_buffer_names( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], )
methods.description: Ensures buffer names are consistent and do not conflict with freeable input buffers.

methods.name: tuple[int,dict[str,FreeableInputBuffer]] prepare_planning_info( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], name_to_fused_node: dict[str, BaseSchedulerNode], graph_inputs: OrderedSet[str], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Prepares buffer and node memory info, estimates peak memory, and sets up for scheduling.

methods.name: list[BaseSchedulerNode] reorder_for_peak_memory( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_buf: dict[str, SchedulerBuffer], name_to_fused_node: dict[str, BaseSchedulerNode], graph_inputs: OrderedSet[str], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], methods: list[Callable[..., list[BaseSchedulerNode]]] = [ topological_sort_lpmf, topological_sort_bfs, topological_sort_dfs, ], )
methods.description: Tries multiple scheduling heuristics and chooses the order resulting in minimal peak memory.

methods.name: None export_graph_for_simulator( nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], name_to_freeable_input_buf: dict[str, FreeableInputBuffer], name_to_fused_node: dict[str, BaseSchedulerNode], graph_inputs: OrderedSet[str], graph_outputs: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Exports a JSON representation of the graph for debugging or analysis via a simulator.
